title: Kerala HC approves State's new guidelines for appointment of Public Prosecutors with limited modifications
description: The Kerala High Court on Wednesday approved the State government's draft guidelines for the appointment of District Government Pleaders, Public Prosecutors and Additional Public Prosecutors, albeit with limited modifications [Adv Sudheer PS v State of Kerala & ors and connected case].
